pairs: De collectis autem, quæ fiunt in sanctos,
Now concerning the collections which are made for the saints:
just as I have arranged for the churches of Galatia,
so should it also be done with you.
Per unam sabbati unusquisque vestrum apud se seponat,
On the first day of the week, the Sabbath, let each one of you take from himself,
recondens quod ei bene placuerit: ut non,
setting aside what will be well-pleasing to him, so that when I arrive,
the collections will not have to be made then.
whomever you shall approve through letters,
hos mittam perferre gratiam vestram in Jerusalem.
these I shall send to bear your gifts to Jerusalem.
Quod si dignum fuerit ut et ego eam,
And if it is fitting for me to go too,
Veniam autem ad vos, cum Macedoniam pertransiero:
Now I will visit you after I have passed through Macedonia.
For I will pass through Macedonia.
And perhaps I will stay with you,
ut vos me deducatis quocumque iero.
so that you may lead me on my way, whenever I depart.
Nolo enim vos modo in transitu videre,
For I am not willing to see you now only in passing,
spero enim me aliquantulum temporis manere apud vos,
since I hope that I may remain with you for some length of time,
Permanebo autem Ephesi usque ad Pentecosten.
But I must remain at Ephesus, even until Pentecost.
Ostium enim mihi apertum est magnum,
For a door, great and unavoidable,
videte ut sine timore sit apud vos:
see to it that he may be among you without fear.
For he is doing the work of the Lord,
Therefore, let no one despise him.
Instead, lead him on his way in peace,
so that he may come to me.
For I am awaiting him with the brothers.
De Apollo autem fratre vobis notum facio,
quoniam multum rogavi eum ut veniret ad vos cum fratribus:
et utique non fuit voluntas ut nunc veniret:
I am letting you know that I pleaded with him greatly to go to you with the brothers,
and clearly it was not his will to go at this time.
But he will arrive when there is a space of time for him.
Let all that is yours be immersed in charity.
You know the house of Stephanus,
that they are the first-fruits of Achaia,
et in ministerium sanctorum ordinaverunt seipsos:
and that they have dedicated themselves to the ministry of the saints.
ut et vos subditi sitis ejusmodi,
So you should be subject also to persons such as this,
as well as to all who are cooperating
Gaudeo autem in præsentia Stephanæ, et Fortunati, et Achaici:
Now I rejoice in the presence of Stephanus and Fortunatus and Achaicus,
because what was lacking in you,
For they have refreshed my spirit and yours.
The churches of Asia greet you.
Aquila and Priscilla greet you greatly in the Lord,
Aquila et Priscilla cum domestica sua ecclesia:
with the church of their household,
where I also am a guest.
Greet one another with a holy kiss.
This is a greeting from my own hand,
Si quis non amat Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum,
If anyone does not love our Lord Jesus Christ,
Gratia Domini nostri Jesu Christi vobiscum.
May the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all.
Caritas mea cum omnibus vobis in Christo Jesu.
My charity is with all of you in Christ Jesus.
